_about: Photo-realistic portrait briefs for every guest and townsfolk look. Keys match PortraitSpec.art (see src/content/index.ts). Each portrait is generated once per mood and cut out; the game shows it in a 100 x 124 box, bottom-aligned, head and shoulders.
style: photograph, head-and-shoulders portrait of {subject}, facing the camera, standing in a dim medieval tavern at night, warm candlelight from the left, soft cool moonlight rim light from behind, shallow depth of field, 85mm lens, photorealistic, natural skin texture, highly detailed, {mood}
negative: cartoon, anime, illustration, painting, drawing, 3d render, cgi, plastic skin, deformed face, asymmetric eyes, extra limbs, extra fingers, text, watermark, logo, frame, border, cropped head, blurry, oversaturated

moods.happy: beaming, delighted smile, eyes crinkled with laughter
moods.surprised: astonished, eyebrows raised high, mouth open in surprise
moods.sad: sad, downcast eyes, a small unhappy frown

characters.guest:barnaby: a cheerful halfling bard in his thirties, short and stocky, with curly chestnut-auburn hair, rosy freckled cheeks and bright wide eyes, wearing a green felt bard's cap with a long red feather and a green tunic with gold trim, a lute strap across his chest
characters.guest:grizelda: a stout dwarf woman blacksmith with a long copper-red beard in thick braids and braided copper hair, a small scar on her cheek and a gold earring, wearing a brown leather cap and a heavy leather smith's apron with steel rivets, soot on her face
characters.guest:fizzlewick: an elderly absent-minded wizard with a very long white beard and long white hair, a wrinkled face and a long nose, round wire spectacles slipping down his nose, wearing a tall floppy purple wizard hat and purple velvet robes embroidered with small yellow stars
characters.guest:pip: a small green-skinned goblin merchant with large pointed ears, a long pointed nose, wide mischievous eyes, wild dark hair and a gold hoop earring, wearing a tattered brown cap with a brass badge and an orange waistcoat, a small brown rat perched on his shoulder
characters.guest:reginald: a pompous middle-aged knight with a magnificent waxed blond handlebar mustache, rosy cheeks and a big nose, wearing an open polished steel helmet with a blue plume and shining plate armour with a blue sash
characters.guest:oakley: an ancient treant, a gentle tree-person whose face is gnarled living oak bark, with a long beard of green moss, small glowing green eyes deep in the bark, a long knobbly branch for a nose, and oak leaves and twigs growing from his head
characters.guest:mortimer: a pale, anxious young necromancer with long straight black hair, dark circles under sleepy nervous eyes and a pointed nose, wearing a deep purple hooded robe with violet trim and a small silver skull pendant
characters.guest:zephyrine: a mysterious fortune teller woman in her fifties with warm brown skin and long dark hair, heavy-lidded knowing eyes lined with kohl, wearing a purple silk headscarf hung with little gold coins, large gold hoop earrings, layered gold necklaces and a teal shawl embroidered with gold
characters.guest:brinebottom: a weathered old retired pirate captain with a long grey beard, sun-tanned wrinkled skin, a big nose, a black eyepatch, a scar across his cheek and a gold earring, wearing a black tricorn hat trimmed with gold and a faded red captain's coat with gold buttons
characters.guest:ledgerly: a small fussy elderly gnome tax inspector with rosy skin, neat white hair, a waxed white mustache, a big nose and a brass monocle, wearing a tall black top hat with a crimson band and a sober grey tailored suit with a crimson cravat
characters.guest:ember: a friendly young red-orange dragon with glossy scales, a golden-cream belly, small curved horns, big shining amber eyes and very polite manners, head and neck
